ambassador.summary: The model is a smiling ambassador in a teal and gold robe with a sealed scroll. It matches the mockup with small differences in the hair, the collar, and the scroll.
strengths: The teal robe, the gold trim, the orange belt, and the red medallion match the mockup palette.
The face reads at 128 px: large eyes, blush, a small smile, and gold hoop earrings.
The bun and the flared sleeves give a clear silhouette from every view.
issues: The bun is too large and has two stacked lobes. Make one smaller bun and add the gold pin on top.
The hair surface is lumpy. Make it smooth and add swept strand grooves toward the bun.
The robe has a straight gold band down the front. The mockup has a crossed wrap collar with gold trim. Change the band to a wrap collar.
The scroll is small, and the hand holds it at the shoulder. Make the scroll larger and lower it to chest height.
In the walk, the robe hides most of the leg motion, and the scroll arm stays still (base limit).
ambassador.next: Make the bun smaller with one lobe and a gold pin, and smooth the hair surface.

commander.summary: The model is a bearded commander in a blue tunic, steel pauldrons, and a blue cape, with a rolled map. It is the same character, but the hair and the map differ clearly from the mockup.
strengths: The blue tunic, the steel pauldrons, the brown strap and belt, and the blue cape match the mockup.
The black beard and the thick brows give a strong face that reads at 128 px.
The cape gives a clear silhouette from the side and the back.
issues: The hair has tall, sharp spikes that look like a crown of horns. The mockup has short, messy tufts. Make the spikes shorter and softer.
The map is a plain cream cylinder. Give it a curled outer edge and a tan parchment color with one or two dark lines.
The brows angle down toward the nose, so the face looks stern. Raise the inner ends of the brows for a kind look.
The lower edge of the hair at the back has a row of round bumps. Make it one smooth edge.
The boots have steel toe caps. The mockup has plain brown boots. Remove the caps.
commander.next: Make the hair spikes short and soft, like the messy tufts in the mockup.

shrine-keeper.summary: The model is a gentle young shrine keeper in white and pale blue robes, with a bell staff and a bowl of glowing water. It matches the mockup with small differences.
strengths: The white robe, the pale blue sash bow and trousers, and the sandals match the mockup.
The bowl has blue glowing water and a steam wisp, so the focal point reads.
The face reads in every sprite direction: large eyes, blush, and a soft smile.
The staff with a crossbar and small gold bells shows the role clearly.
issues: The sleeve on the staff arm is a round ball. Make it a long, wide sleeve that hangs down, like the sleeve on the bowl arm.
Two hair tufts on top curl up like horns. Make the top hair soft and messy, with a fringe over the brow.
The trousers are narrow. The mockup has wide pale blue hakama trousers. Make the trouser legs wider.
The feet have white socks. The mockup shows bare feet in the sandals. Paint the feet skin color.
In the walk, the staff arm stays still (base limit).
shrine-keeper.next: Change the round staff-arm sleeve to a long, wide sleeve that hangs down.

diplomat.summary: The model is a friendly young diplomat in a cream and green coat, with an olive branch and a scroll. It is the same character, but the hair color and the hair shape differ clearly from the mockup.
strengths: The cream coat, the dark green collar, the green bow, the green cuffs, and the gold buttons match the mockup.
The olive branch has clear green leaves and reads at 128 px.
The brown boots and the double row of buttons give a clean, calm detail plan.
issues: The hair is a light caramel color, near the skin value. The mockup hair is dark brown. Make the hair dark brown, so the face has a clear frame.
The hair has rows of lumpy ridges, most visible from the back. Make a smooth side-parted shape with volume on top, as in the mockup.
The scroll is small, and the hand holds it low. Make the scroll larger and raise it to shoulder height.
The smile is small. The mockup has a wide smile. Make the mouth wider.
A dark, ragged edge shows at the back collar under the hair. Close the gap between the hair and the collar.
diplomat.next: Make the hair dark brown with a smooth side-parted shape.

general.summary: The model is a general in a red coat with gold epaulettes, a blue sash, and a plumed bicorne hat. The costume matches the mockup, but the face reads as a young boy and not as a kind old man.
strengths: The red coat, the gold epaulettes, the blue sash, the white front, and the black boots match the mockup palette.
The wide black hat with a white plume gives a strong silhouette from every view.
The gray side hair and the gray braid at the back show age from the side and the back.
issues: The face reads as a young boy. The brows are dark brown and the face has no age lines. Add white bushy eyebrows, soft cheek lines, and larger ears.
The mouth is a small smile. The mockup has a wide, warm smile. Make the smile wider.
The telescope is a thin gold rod with a round end, so it looks like a baton. Make a thicker brass tube with steps and a dark lens at the end.
The hat badge is a gold disc with a mark. The mockup has a red star on the badge. Paint a red star on it.
The coat has no black collar at the neck. Add the black collar from the mockup.
general.next: Add white bushy eyebrows and a wide smile, so the face reads as a kind old man.
